stories.title: Bills star DT Oliver mourning tragic death of son
stories.summary: The 2-year-old son of Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver died June 28 after he was found unresponsive in a swimming pool by family members at a residence outside Houston.

stories.title: Madrid strike late to give Mourinho winning return
stories.summary: José Mourinho's second spell in charge of Real Madrid got off to a winning start, thanks to new signing Carlos Espí's 90th-minute goal to claim a 2-1 victory at Espanyol.

stories.title: McCarthy starts, gets 'banged up' in Vikings' loss
stories.summary: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy, who ended up with 18 snaps, would have played longer Saturday if he had not gotten "banged up" during a rough first quarter in the Minnesota Vikings' 13-3 preseason loss to the Baltimore Ravens, coach Kevin O'Connell said.

stories.title: Stewart wants safe space amid transgender rallies
stories.summary: Liberty star Breanna Stewart says she hopes WNBA arenas can be a "safe space" for fans amid rallies about transgender sports participation.

stories.title: Penix fully cleared as Falcons ramp up QB1 battle
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. has been cleared to practice fully, head coach Kevin Stefanski said after Saturday's 34-6 preseason win over the Colts.
